dedupe_keys.name: synthfirm firm synthesizer and supply chain simulator

description: SynthFirm is a national-scale agent-based freight demand model that generates a complete synthetic population of firms in the United States and the business-to-business commodity flows between them. Using publicly available data sources as inputs, it simulates firm and fleet characteristics, commodity production and consumption, the formation of supply chains and the choice of shipping mode, which drive commodity flows at a disaggregate level. Version 2.0, released on 2025-11-20, adds national commercial vehicle fleet generation, international trade simulation and an automated model validation pipeline, so freight inventories can be built for the whole country or a selected region. Coverage is the United States. Access: open source under the BSD 3-clause licence, with the code in a public GitHub repository and DOE CODE records for versions 1.0 and 2.0 (DOI 10.11578/dc.20251217.1), sponsored by the US Department of Energy. Caveats: outputs are synthetic and depend on the public input data, and running it at national scale needs substantial data preparation. It supports freight network flow and supply chain disruption studies, agent-based freight demand for traffic models and freight scenario analysis, and complements the Freight Analysis Framework catalogued here.
name: SynthFirm, Firm Synthesizer and Supply-chain Simulator
